subject: Phase 2 — Sprint: regenerateTasksMd.ts generator tool
instruction: Create sprint for the TASKS.md generator. Decompose into 4 atomic tasks as specified in Section 8 of the brief: (A) regenerateTasksMd.ts implementation, (B) golden-file unit tests, (C) pm+qa flow edits stripping manual TASKS.md writes, (D) tree-map.md + bookkeeping-protocol.md updates. Assign to dev-mcp-server (A+B) and developer (C+D). Do not start until Phase 1 (agent-father flow edit) is merged to main.
